name: ngini-image-bridge
description: Generate images in Claude. Keep prompts short to avoid errors. Estimated daily free allowance: 5–10 generations; actual limits are set by Ngini.
long_description:
Generate images in Claude. Keep prompts as short as possible; longer prompts may cause errors. Estimated daily free allowance: 5–10 generations, subject to Ngini's current limits.

Unofficial integration. Images are generated by Ngini through your local browser, and image prompts are sent to Ngini. Tested on Windows 11 with Claude Desktop; clean Windows installation testing was waived by the project owner. See the included setup guide for image-only replies and compatibility limits.

tools.name: ngini_generate_image
tools.description: Submit one guest Ngini generation using the user's short subject, action and setting description verbatim. Preserve their language and explicit requirements; add no unrequested details.

tools.name: ngini_get_result
tools.description: Explicitly reopen an existing image card; use ngini_get_status for waiting. Never submit another generation.

tools.name: ngini_get_status
tools.description: Read an existing request without opening another image card; never submit another generation.

tools.name: ngini_cancel_generation
tools.description: Stop local processing; provider cancellation and quota refunds are not guaranteed.

tools.name: ngini_read_image
tools.description: Image-card access to a small original already stored by this tool; no file path, URL, or generation access.

tools.name: ngini_read_image_chunk
tools.description: Read a fixed-size original image chunk for the image card; no generation, file path, or URL access.

tools.name: ngini_report_delivery
tools.description: Record card preview or host download acceptance without claiming that the original was saved.

visible_browser.title: 顯示網站瀏覽器（人工驗證／疑難排解）
visible_browser.description: 預設關閉，正常生成在背景執行。網站要求人工驗證時可自行開啟並重新啟動外掛；沿用同一專用 profile，不會重新送出原任務。未提交的原頁面在重啟後不能自動接續。

diagnostic_fixture.title: 本機測試圖片（不使用 Ngini）
diagnostic_fixture.description: P0 診斷用：僅建立標示測試圖，驗證聊天顯示及原圖下載；不代表真實生圖已完成。
